examples.title: Converting Numbers to Words
steps: Identify the period for the first group: 23 is in the 'thousands' period.
Identify the next group: 456 is in the 'ones' period.
Combine them: Twenty-three thousand four hundred fifty-six.

examples.title: Place Value Identification
examples.problem: Find the place value of 7 in 87,210.
steps: Write the number in a place value chart.
Digit 0 is in Ones, 1 is in Tens, 2 is in Hundreds, 7 is in Thousands.
